Overview

Bhubaneswar is a city in Odisha with a population of 1,200,000. The capital of Odisha, known as the Temple City for its thousand-year-old temples, and a growing IT and education hub. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
